sources.title: Langara College Statement of Financial Information 2023/24 — named employee gross pay and expenses
sources.publicWarning: Published individual gross-pay cells sum $6 below the printed named control and expense cells sum $16 above it. All 891 rows were checked in two OCR configurations and against source pixels. Literal employee amounts are retained without balancing adjustments; expense dashes remain null.
notes: Complete employee schedule only; board, suppliers, below-threshold aggregates, severance and other financial reconciliation amounts are excluded.
The published remuneration column is Gross pay, not inferred annual base salary or a total including separate expenses.

The printed cohort label is Total of Employees Earning > $75,000, but 31 individually disclosed gross-pay cells are at or below $75,000. All named source rows are retained without inferring another threshold measure.

Two OCR configurations read all 891 rows and 1,782 monetary cells; every name, position and monetary cell was then checked against source pixels. Raw disagreements and explicit text corrections remain in evidence.
Both OCR passes misread Zanzerl, Heather as Zanzerl|, Heather. A six-times source crop resolves the literal printed surname. Todd Stuckless, J. retains its printed initial period.
All compiled observations and original labels are retained. Repeated names with different pay or positions remain separate source occurrences.

independentReaders: Complete manual source-pixel review of all four employee columns
validation.agreementBasis: OCR text fields after documented source-pixel corrections; all raw OCR readings are retained.
